instruction: VERIFY 鍮좊Ⅸ?꾪닾 CORE packet-drive (cycle 161, OAAW, FULLY UNMANNED, NORTH STAR). cycle160 was a BUILD FAIL ONLY: fbShadowB packet-drive called fbHookLog before its definition -> C3861.
